hub.title: Local Web UIs
hub.description: Open the web UIs of local devices and sites inside Home Assistant. This entry holds the options for all of them. Devices that link to a local web page (for example ESPHome with web_server) will be offered under Discovered; other sites are added with "Add entry".

web_ui.title: Add a web UI
web_ui.description: Any web page your Home Assistant server can reach: a device, a router, a printer, another server.

data.name: Name
data.trusted_acknowledged: I understand that a trusted web UI gets full administrator control of Home Assistant

data_description.url: The full address of the page, including http or https and the port if it is not the default.
data_description.mode: Isolated (recommended) keeps the page away from Home Assistant: it cannot read Home Assistant's data or act as you, while its logins and storage still work. Trusted runs it with Home Assistant's own origin, which a few pages need (for example ones using IndexedDB). A trusted page's scripts get full administrator control of Home Assistant, so only use it for pages you fully trust.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off for devices with self-signed certificates.
data_description.username: Optional. Sent as HTTP Basic authentication so you are not prompted.
data_description.password: Optional. When editing, leave empty to keep the stored password.
data_description.show_in_sidebar: Add a sidebar entry that opens this web UI directly.

hub.title: Local Web UIs options
hub.description: Options for all web UIs. Each web UI has settings of its own: the gear of its entry. The list of web UIs is at [Local Web UIs]({panel_url}).

data.show_panel: Show the list of web UIs in the sidebar

data_description.discovery: Offer devices whose integration links to a local web page (their "Visit" button), such as ESPHome devices with web_server, WLED or printers. They appear under Discovered, where you add or ignore each.
data_description.link_device_pages: The default for each web UI of a device: point the device's own "Visit" button at its web UI here, so it also works away from home. Each web UI can choose otherwise in its settings. Turning it off restores the original links.
data_description.show_panel: The web UIs' own pages keep working when the list is hidden.
data_description.panel_icon: Icon of the list in the sidebar.
data_description.local_domains: Additional domain suffixes to treat as local network for discovery (space- or comma-separated). By default, .local and .home.arpa are accepted.
